reference: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.
hypothesis: Joining such a network usually requires only filling out an online form; however, some sites will offer or require additional verification.

source: Orodha ya wenyeji wanaopatikana hutolewa kwa kuchapishwa kwenye nakala na/au mitandaoni, wakati mwingine pamoja na marejeleo na hakiki kutoka kwa wasafiri wengine.
reference: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.
hypothesis: A list of available hosts is provided in print and/or online, sometimes along with references and reviews from other travelers.

source: Kulala kwenye nyumba za watu kwa muda kulianzishwa mnamo Januari 2004 baada ya mtengenezaji wa programu za kompyuta Casey Fenton kupata safari ya ndege ya bei nafuu kuelekea Aislandi lakini hakuwa na mahali pa kukaa.
reference: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.
hypothesis: The idea of a homestay was born in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but had no place to stay.

source: Akawatumia wanafunzi wa chuo kikuu chaa ndani barua pepe na akapata matoleo mengi sana ya malazi ya bure.
reference: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.
hypothesis: She sent e-mails to students at a local university and received many offers of free accommodation.

source: Hosteli hushughulikia vijana kimsingi - mgeni wa kawaida ana miaka ishirini hivi - lakini mara nyingi unaweza kuwapata wasafiri wazee huko pia.
reference: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.
hypothesis: Hostels cater primarily to young people - the typical guest is in his twenties - but you can often find older travelers there too.

source: Familia zilizo na watoto si jambo la kawaida, lakini baadhi ya hosteli huwaruhusu katika vyumba vya kibinafsi.
reference: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.
hypothesis: Families with children are not common, but some hostels allow them in private rooms.

source: Mji wa Beijing nchini Uchina utakuwa mji mwenyeji wa mashindano ya Olimpiki ya Msimu wa Baridi mwaka wa 2022, ambayo itaifanya Beijing kuwa mji wa kwanza kuwa mwenyeji wa Olimpiki ya majira ya joto na baridi.
reference: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.
hypothesis: Beijing, China will host the 2022 Winter Olympics, making Beijing the first city to host both the summer and winter Olympics.

source: Beijing itakuwa mwenyeji wa sherehe za kufungua na kufunga na matukio ya ndani kwenye barafu.
reference: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.
hypothesis: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and indoor events on ice.

source: Matukio mengine ya kuteleza kwenye theluji yatakuwa katika eneo la Taizicheng katika Zhangjiakou, takribani kilomita 220 (maili 140) kutoka Beijing.
reference: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.
hypothesis: The next skiing event will be in the Taizicheng area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 kilometers (140 miles) from Beijing.

source: Hekalu nyingi zina sikukuu ya Kila mwaka kuanzia mwishoni mwa Novemba hadi katikati mwa Mei, ambayo hufautiana kulingana na kalenda ya mwaka ya kila hekalu.
reference: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.
hypothesis: Most temples have a New Year from late November to mid-May, which varies according to the calendar year of each temple.

source: Sherehe nyingi za Hekaluni zinaadhimishwa kama sehemu ya maadhimisho ya hekalu au siku ya kuzaliwa kwa mungu anayeongoza au tukio lolote jingine kuu linalohusiana na hekalu.
reference: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.
hypothesis: Many temple festivals are celebrated as part of a temple festival or the birthday of the presiding deity or some other major event connected with the temple.

source: Tamasha za hekalu za Kerala ni za kufurahisha sana kuona, kwa msafara wa mara kwa mara wa ndovu waliopambwa, bendi za hekalu na tamasha nyinginezo.
reference: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.
hypothesis: Kerala's temple festivals are a delight to behold, with regular processions of decorated elephants, temple bands, and other spectacles.

source: Maonyesho ya Dunia (kwa kawaida yanajulikana kama World Exposition, au Expo tu) ni tamasha kubwa ya kimataifa ya sanaa na sayansi.
reference: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.
hypothesis: The World's Fair (commonly known as the World Exposition, or simply the Expo) is a major international art and science festival.

source: Nchi zinazoshiriki huwasilisha maonyesho ya kisanaa na kielimu katika kumbi za kitaifa ili kuonyesha masuala ya kidunia au utamaduni na historia ya nchi yao.
reference: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.
hypothesis: Participating countries present artistic and educational exhibitions in national halls to highlight secular issues or their country's culture and history.

source: Maonyesho ya Kimataifa ya Maua ni matukio maalum ambayo huonyesha maonyesho ya maua, bustani za mimea na kitu chochote kingine kinachohusisha mimea.
reference: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.
hypothesis: International Flower Shows are special events that feature flower shows, botanical gardens, and anything else that involves plants.

source: Ingawa katika nadharia zinaweza kutokea kila mwaka (mradi zako katika nchi tofauti), kwa mazoezi hazipo.
reference: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.
hypothesis: While in theory they can happen every year (your projects in different countries), in practice they don't.

source: Matukio hayo huwa kwa miezi mitatu hadi miezi sita, na hufanyika kwenye maeneo yasiyopungua hekta 50.
reference: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
hypothesis: These events last from three to six months and take place on an area of at least 50 hectares.

source: Kuna aina nyingi za filamu ambazo zimetumika kwa miaka. Filamu ya milimita 35 (kanda hasi ya milimita 36 kwa milimita 24) ni ya kawaida zaidi.
reference: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.
hypothesis: Many types of film have been used over the years, the most common being the 35 - millimeter negative (36 - by 24 - millimeter negative).

source: Kwa kawaida inaweza kujazwa tena kwa urahisi kiasi ikiisha, na hutoa ubora wa mwonekano unaoweza kulinganishwa na ule wa DSLR ya sasa.
reference: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.
hypothesis: It can usually be easily refilled when the volume runs out, and it produces image quality comparable to that of a modern DSLR.

source: Kamera ingine za muundo wa kati zinatumia muundo wa 6 kwa 6, kwa usahihi 56 kwa 56 hasi.
reference: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.
hypothesis: Other medium format cameras use a 6 by 6 format, with a resolution of 56 by 56 negatives.

source: Hii hutoa ubora wa mwonekano karibu mara nne ya ule wa picha hasi ya milimita 35 (3136 mm2 dhidi ya 864).
reference: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).
hypothesis: This gives a visual quality almost four times that of a 35 - millimeter negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

source: Wanyama pori ni miongoni mwa michoro yenye changamoto zaidi kwa mpiga picha, na inahitaji mchanganyiko wa bahati nzuri, uvumilivu, uzoefu na vifaa vizuri.
reference: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.
hypothesis: Wildlife is among the most challenging subjects for a photographer, and requires a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

source: Upigaji picha za wanyamapori mara nyingi huchukuliwa kwa urahisi, lakini kama upigaji picha kwa ujumla, picha ina thamani ya maneno elfu.
reference: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.
hypothesis: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but as with photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

source: Mara nyingi upigaji picha za wanyamapori huhitaji lenzi ndefu, ingawa vitu kama kundi la ndege au kiumbe mdogo huhitaji lenzi nyingine.
reference: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.
hypothesis: Wildlife photography often requires a long lens, although subjects such as a flock of birds or a small creature may require a different lens.

source: Ni vigumu kupata wanyama wengi wa kigeni, na mbuga wakati mwingine huwa na sheria zinazohusu upigaji picha kwa ajili za kibiashara.
reference: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.
hypothesis: Many exotic animals are difficult to find, and zoos sometimes have restrictions on commercial photography.

source: Wanyamapori wanaweza kuwa wenye aibu au wakali. Mazingira yanaweza kuwa baridi, joto, au makali kwa vinginevyo.
reference: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.
hypothesis: Wildlife can be shy or aggressive, and the environment can be cold, hot, or otherwise harsh.

source: Ulimwengu una zaidi ya lugha 5,000, zikiwemo zaidi ya ishirini zilizo na wazungumzaji zaidi ya milioni 50.
reference: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.
hypothesis: The world has more than 5,000 languages, including more than two dozen with more than 50 million speakers.

source: Maneno yaliyoandikwa mara nyingi huwa rahisi kuelewa kuliko maneno yaliyotamkwa, pia. Hii huwa hususan ni kweli kwa anwani, ambazo aghalabu huwa vigumu kutamkwa kwa busara.
reference: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.
hypothesis: The written word is often easier to understand than the spoken word, too. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligently.

source: Mataifa mengi mazima huzungumza Kiingereza kwa ufasaha kabisa, na kwa hata mengine mengi unaweza kutarajia ufahamu mdogo - hasa miongoni mwa watu wenye umri mdogo.
reference: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.
hypothesis: Many entire nations speak English quite fluently, and for even more you can expect limited understanding - especially among younger people.

source: Fikiria, ukitaka, Mmankunia, Mbostonia, Mjamaika, na Msydney wakiwa wameketi wamezunguka meza wakila chajio mkahawani katika Toronto.
reference: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.
hypothesis: Imagine, if you will, a Cree, a Bostonian, a Jamaican, and a Sydney sitting around a table eating a sandwich in a Toronto restaurant.

source: Wanaburudishana na hadithi kutoka kwa mitaa ya manyumbani kwao, inayosemwa katika lafudhi zao tofauti na lugha ya kienyeji isiyo rasmi.
reference: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.
hypothesis: They entertain themselves with stories from their home streets, told in their own dialect and in the informal local language.

source: Kwa kawaida, kununua chakula katika supamaketi ndiyo njia ya bei rahisi kabisa ya kujilisha. Bila fursa za kupika, machaguo hata hivyo yamepunguzwa kwa chakula kilichotengenezwa tayari.
reference: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.
hypothesis: Buying food in a supermarket is usually the cheapest way to feed yourself. Without cooking facilities, the choices are however limited to ready-made food.

source: Maduka makubwa yanazidi kupata seehemu ya chakula kilichotengenezwa tayari. Baadhi ya maduka makuu hutoa tanuri ya miale ya kupasha chakula joto.
reference: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.
hypothesis: Supermarkets are increasingly offering a ready-to-eat section, and some even offer microwave ovens.

source: Katika baadhi ya nchi au aina za maduka kuna angalau mkahawa kwenye eneo, mara nyingi usio wa kirasmi na wenye bei nafuu.
reference: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.
hypothesis: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one restaurant in the area, often informal and inexpensive.

source: Tengeneza na ubebe nakala za hati ya bima na maelezo ya mawasiliano ya mtoa huduma wako wa bima.
reference: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.
hypothesis: Make and keep copies of your insurance policy and contact information for your insurance provider.

source: Wanahitaji kuonyesha anwani ya barua pepe na nambari za simu za kimataifa za mtoa bima kwa ushauri/idhini na kufanya madai.
reference: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.
hypothesis: They need to show an email address and international phone numbers of the insurer for advice/authorization and to make a claim.

source: Kuwa na nakala nyingine katika mzigo wako na mtandaoni (baruapepe iliyo na kiambatisho kwako mwenyewe, au kuhifahiwa kwenye “wingu”).
reference: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").
hypothesis: Have another copy in your trunk and online (email with attachment to yourself, or stored in the cloud).

source: Kama unafasiri na kipakatilishi au kibao, hifadhi nakala kwenye kadi kasima yake(unayoweza kufikia bila mtandao)
reference: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).
hypothesis: If you are translating on a laptop or tablet, save the translated text on a memory card (that you can access offline)

source: Pia toa nakala za sera/mkataba kwa wenzi wa kusafiri na jamaa au marafiki nyumbani walio tayari kusaidia.
reference: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.
hypothesis: Also provide copies of the policy/ contract to traveling mates and relatives or friends back home who are willing to help.

source: Kongoni (pia wanajulikana kama elk) hawana fujo kiasili, lakini watajitetea ikiwa watakisia kuna hatari.
reference: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.
hypothesis: Moose are not aggressive by nature, but they will defend themselves if they sense danger.

source: Wakati watu hawaoni kongoni kama anayeweza kuwa hatari, huenda wakamsogea karibu sana na kujiweka hatarini.
reference: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.
hypothesis: When people do not view the moose as a potential threat, they may get too close and endanger themselves.

source: Kunywa vinywaji vyenye pombe kwa kiasi tu. Pombe inaathiri kila mtu kwa njia tofauti, na kujua kiwango chako ni muhimu sana.
reference: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.
hypothesis: Moderate use of alcohol. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is important.

source: Matukio ya kiafya ya muda mrefu kutokana na kunywa kupita kiasi yanaweza kujumuisha uharibifu wa ini na hata upofu na kifo. Kuwepo kwa hatari huongezeka wakati wa kunywa pombe iliyotengenezwa kiharamu.
reference: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.
hypothesis: Long-term health effects from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The risk increases with the consumption of illegally produced alcohol.

source: Mivinyo isiyo halali inaweza kuwa na uchafu mwingi hatari pamoja na methanoli, ambayo inaweza kusababisha upofu au kifo hata kwa kiasi kidogo.
reference: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.
hypothesis: Illegal vaporizers can contain dangerous levels of contaminants, including methanol, which can cause blindness or death in even small amounts.

source: Miwani inaweza kuwa bei rahisi katika nchi ya kigeni, haswa katika nchi za mapato ya chini ambapo gharama za kazi ziko chini.
reference: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.
hypothesis: Eyeglasses can be cheap in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labor costs are low.

source: Fikiria kufanyiwa uchunguzi wa macho nyumbani, haswa ikiwa bima inaugharamia, na kuleta agizo nawe ili lifailiwe mahali pengine.
reference: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.
hypothesis: Consider having an eye exam at home, especially if insurance will cover it, and bring the prescription with you to be filed elsewhere.

source: Fremu za kifahari za kampuni tajika ambazo hupatikana katika maeneo kama haya zina shida mbili; baadhi huenda zikawa ni nakala zisizo na leseni, na zile halisi zilizoletwa ndani huenda zikawa ghali zaidi kuliko nyumbani.
reference: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.
hypothesis: The luxury frames of wealthy companies found in such places have two drawbacks; some may be pirated copies, and the imported originals may be more expensive than at home.

source: Kahawa ni mojawapo ya bidhaa zinazouzwa sana duniani, na labda unaweza kupata aina nyingi katika eneo lako la nyumbani.
reference: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.
hypothesis: Coffee is one of the world's most profitable commodities, and you can likely find many varieties in your area.

source: Walakini, kuna njia nyingi za kipekee za kunywa kahawa ulimwenguni kote ambazo zinafaa kushuhudiwa.
reference: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.
hypothesis: However, there are many unique ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

source: Kuingia kwenye korongo (au: canyoneering) ni kuhusu kwenda chini ya korongo, ambayo imekauka au imejawa na maji.
reference: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.
hypothesis: Canyoneering is about going down a canyon, which is either dry or filled with water.

source: Mchezo wa korongo huchanganya vipengele kutoka kuogelea, kupanda na kuruka--lakini unahitaji mafunzo kiasi au hali nzuri ya kimwili ili kuanza (ukilinganishwa na kupanda mwamba, upigaji mbizi wa scuba au kuteleza milimani, kwa mfano).
reference: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).
hypothesis: The sport of canoeing combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping - but it requires some training or good physical condition to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or skiing, for example).

source: Matembezi ni shughuli ya nje ambayo huwa na kutembea katika mazingira asili, mara nyingi katika njia za matembezi.
reference: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.
hypothesis: Hiking is an outdoor activity that consists of walking in natural surroundings, often on footpaths.

source: Matembezi ya mchana huhusisha umbali wa chini ya maili hadi umbali zaidi ambao unaweza kufikiwa kwa siku moja.
reference: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.
hypothesis: Day hikes range from less than a mile to as far as you can walk in a day.

source: Kwa matembezi ya mchana kando ya njia rahisi maandalizi kidogo yanahitajika, na mtu yeyote aliye na usawa wastani wa kimwili anaweza kufurahia.
reference: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.
hypothesis: Daytime walks along easy trails require little preparation, and anyone of moderate physical fitness can enjoy them.

source: Huenda familia zilizo na watoto wadogo zikahitaji matayarisho mengi, lakini siku moja nje inawezekana kwa urahisi hata kukiwa na watoto wachanga na wale walio karibu kwenda shuleni.
reference: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.
hypothesis: Families with small children may need to make extensive preparations, but a day out is easily possible even with toddlers and those about to start school.

source: Kimataifa, kuna mashirika karibu 200 ya ziara za mbio. Nyingi kati yazo hufanya kazi kwa uhuru.
reference: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.
hypothesis: Worldwide, there are about 200 race tour companies, most of them operating independently.

source: Mrithi wa Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours huunganisha makundi mengi ya kutoa huduma ya ukimbiaji na utazamaji kwenye mabara manne.
reference: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.
hypothesis: The successor to Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours brings together many running and spectator groups on four continents.

source: Kwa mizizi ya Running Tours huko Barcelona na Copenhagen’s Running kwa Copenhagen, ilijumuishwa haraka na Running Tours huko Prague na wengineo.
reference: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.
hypothesis: With roots in Running Tours in Barcelona and Copenhagens Running for Copenhagen, it was quickly integrated by Running Tours in Prague and others.

source: Kuna mambo mengi sana unayofaa kutilia maanani kabla na wakati wa kusafiri mahali.
reference: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.
hypothesis: There are so many things to consider before and during a trip.

source: Unaposafiri, tarajia mambo yasiwe kama yalivyo “nyumbani”. Tabia, sheria, chakula, trafiki, mahali pa kulala, viwango, lugha na kadhalika zitatofautiana kwa kiwango fulani na mahali unapoishi.
reference: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.
hypothesis: When you travel, expect things to be different from  home - customs, laws, food, traffic, accommodations, standards, language, and so on.

source: Hili ni jambo ambalo unahitaji kukumbuka kila wakati, ili kuepuka kukata tamaa au hata kuchukizwa na njia za kawaida za kufanya mambo.
reference: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.
hypothesis: This is something you need to keep in mind, lest you become frustrated or even disgusted with the conventional ways of doing things.

source: Mawakala wa usafiri wamekuwapo tangu karne ya 19. Kwa kawaida wakala wa usafiri huwa chaguo zuri kwa safari ambayo ni zaidi ya uzoefu wa awali wa msafiri wa maumbile, utamaduni, lugha au nchi za mapato madogo.
reference: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.
hypothesis: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agency is usually a good choice for a trip that is beyond the traveler's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

source: Ingawa mashirika mengi ya uwakala yako tayari kufanya uhifadhi mwingi wa kawaida, mawakala wengi hushughulika na aina maalum za usafiri, masafa ya bajeti au mahali pa kwenda.
reference: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.
hypothesis: While most agencies are willing to handle most routine bookings, many deal with specific types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

source: Inaweza kuwa afadhali kutumia wakala ambaye huhifadhi safari sawa na yako kila wakati.
reference: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.
hypothesis: It may be better to use an agent who always books the same trip as you.

source: Angalia ni safari zipi ambazo wakala anapendekeza, iwe kwenye tovuti au kwenye dirisha la duka.
reference: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.
hypothesis: Check what tours the agency recommends, either on the website or in a store window.

source: Ikiwa unataka kuuona ulimwengu kwa urahisi, kwa umuhimu, mtindo wa maisha au chamgamoto, kuna baadhi ya njia za kufanya hivyo.
reference: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.
hypothesis: If you want to see the world in a simple way, by relevance, lifestyle or passion, there are a few ways to do it.

source: Kimsingi wao huwa katika vikundi viwili: fanya kazi ukiwa safarini ama jaribu upunguze gharama zako. Nakala hii inaangazia wa mwisho.
reference: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.
hypothesis: They fall into two basic categories: working on the go or trying to cut costs.

source: Kwa wale walio tayari kuacha starehe, muda na utabiri ili kupunguza garama hadi sufuri, angalia usafiri wa bajeti ndogo.
reference: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.
hypothesis: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to reduce costs to zero, consider low-budget travel.

source: Ushauri huo unachukulia kuwa wasafiri hawaibi, hawana uingiliaji, hawashiriki katika soko haramu, hawaombi, au kunyonya watu wengine kwa faida yao.
